crossRefs.note: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
The sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.

people.name: Assir
people.line: Son of Korah who is grandson of Kohath

people.name: Izhar
people.line: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi; father of Korah.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants
